from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Anatomy of a Pure Wave", [
            "Sine waves are defined by height, speed, and phase.",
            "Rotation on a circle generates these fundamental oscillations.",
            "Pure waves of different frequencies never interfere with identity."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF0000")
        
        # Setup Circle and Wave Tracing
        circle = Circle(radius=0.8, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(circle, "C2")
        
        time_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        # The dot on the circle
        dot = Dot(color="#FF0000")
        dot.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(circle.point_at_angle(time_tracker.get_value())))
        
        # Sine wave graph area
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 4, 1],
            y_range=[-1.5, 1.5, 1],
            x_length=3.5,
            y_length=2.5,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "color": WHITE}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "C3", "E6")
        
        # Tracing point and path
        # The tracing point moves horizontally while its Y coordinate matches the dot
        tracing_point = Dot(color="#FF0000", radius=0.01) # invisible or very small
        
        def update_tracing_point(tp):
            t = time_tracker.get_value()
            # Map t to x in axes, y is sin(t)
            # x goes from 0 to 4 over the animation
            x_val = (t % 4) 
            y_val = np.sin(t)
            tp.move_to(axes.c2p(x_val, y_val))

        tracing_point.add_updater(update_tracing_point)
        
        # Use a trail to show the wave
        wave_trail = TracedPath(tracing_point.get_center, stroke_color="#FF0000", stroke_width=4)

        # Horizontal line connecting dot and tracing point
        connecting_line = always_redraw(lambda: Line(
            dot.get_center(),
            tracing_point.get_center(),
            stroke_width=1,
            stroke_opacity=0.5,
            color=WHITE
        ))

        self.play(Create(circle), Create(axes))
        self.add(dot, tracing_point, wave_trail, connecting_line)
        self.play(time_tracker.animate.set_value(4), run_time=4, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE) # Storyboard says White labels
        
        # Labels for Amplitude and Frequency
        amp_line = Line(circle.get_center(), circle.get_top(), color="#00FFFF")
        amp_label = Text("Amplitude", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(amp_label, "B1")
        
        freq_label = Text("Frequency (n)", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(freq_label, "A2")
        
        self.play(Create(amp_line), Write(amp_label), Write(freq_label))
        self.play(time_tracker.animate.set_value(8), run_time=4, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(amp_line), FadeOut(amp_label), FadeOut(freq_label), 
            FadeOut(circle), FadeOut(dot), FadeOut(wave_trail), FadeOut(axes),
            FadeOut(connecting_line), FadeOut(tracing_point)
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FFFF")
        
        # Two waves showing different frequencies sin(x), sin(2x)
        axes_comp = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 2*PI, PI],
            y_range=[-1.5, 1.5, 1],
            x_length=5,
            y_length=3,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes_comp, "B2", "E6")
        
        sin1 = axes_comp.plot(lambda x: np.sin(x), color="#FFFF00")
        sin2 = axes_comp.plot(lambda x: np.sin(2*x), color="#00FFFF")
        
        label1 = MathTex("\\sin(x)", color="#FFFF00", font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(label1, "B5")
        
        label2 = MathTex("\\sin(2x)", color="#00FFFF", font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(label2, "E5")
        
        self.play(Create(axes_comp))
        self.play(Create(sin1), Write(label1))
        self.play(Create(sin2), Write(label2))
        self.wait(3)
